Definition: A control where a person types and edits many lines of text.
The part of the text a person has highlighted, with the mouse or with Shift and the arrow keys.
The position of a character in the text, counting from 0. In "Hello world!" the w is at index 6.
A strip down the left side of a text box, such as the line numbers in a code editor.
A change in how part of the text looks, such as its color or an underline.
An algorithm in many text boxes that changes or marks words it thinks are misspelled.
Using technology to do work that people used to do by hand.
